h: Tonto Dikeh's growing ministry draws attention as a prophecy video goes viral
p: A viral video reportedly shows a prophet urging Tonto Dikeh to get a medical check-up, as her ministry draws growing attention online. The actress has not been reported to have responded, and reactions are split.
more: Fans have flooded the comments with prayers and questions.
Her recent move into ministry has kept her in the headlines.
